svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="bkuZyyvTWc85PSbREiQC" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="4995" dy="2665" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant Auth as authenticate<br/>(middleware)
 participant Redis as Redis
 participant RL as rateLimiter<br/>(middleware)
 participant Ctrl as Auth Controller
 participant Svc as Auth Service
 participant Prisma as Prisma
 participant DB as PostgreSQL

 C->>+Auth: POST /v1/auth/logout/all<br/>Authorization: Bearer accessToken

 Auth->>Auth: verify JWT signature

 alt no token or invalid signature
 Auth-->>C: 401 No token / Invalid token
 else signature valid
 Auth->>+Redis: GET blacklist:<accessToken>
 Redis-->>-Auth: not found

 alt token already blacklisted
 Auth-->>C: 401 Token has been invalidated
 else not blacklisted
 Note over Auth: attach userId, role, exp<br/>to req.user
 Auth->>+RL: rate limit check<br/>identifyBy: userId
 RL->>+Redis: INCR rl:logout-all:per-minute:user:<userId>
 Note over RL,Redis: Lua script — atomic<br/>INCR + EXPIRE
 Redis-->>-RL: count
 RL-->>-Auth: ok

 alt over 5/min
 Auth-->>C: 429 Too Many Requests<br/>Retry-After: <ttl>
 else within limits
 Auth->>+Ctrl: forward request<br/>{ userId, accessToken, exp }
 Ctrl->>+Svc: logoutAllDevices(userId, accessToken, exp)

 Note over Svc: remainingSeconds =<br/>exp - now (floor, min 1)
 Svc->>Svc: calculate TTL

 par blacklist access token
 Svc->>+Redis: SET blacklist:<accessToken><br/>value = userId, EX = remainingSeconds
 Redis-->>-Svc: OK
 and revoke every active refresh token
 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.updateMany(<br/>{ userId, revoked: false },<br/>{ revoked: true })
 Note over Prisma,DB: hits partial index<br/>on (user_id) WHERE revoked = FALSE<br/>— efficient even with many tokens
 Prisma->>+DB: UPDATE auth.refresh_tokens<br/>SET revoked = TRUE<br/>WHERE user_id = $1<br/>AND revoked = FALSE
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack
 end

 Svc->>+Prisma: auditLog.create({ userId, event: 'user.logout_all' })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO auth.audit_logs (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc-->>-Ctrl: ack
 Ctrl-->>-C: 200 Logged out from all devices
 end
 end
 end
",
